- Initial release of the Livecheck skill for real-time verification of listings, product pages, and job postings.
- Supports status checking (live/closed/unknown), one-shot condition checks (price threshold, keyword, etc.), and 30-day URL watchers with webhook notifications.
- Provides concise endpoints for verifying availability, running specific checks, watching pages for changes, and confirming submissions or orders.
- Designed for tasks like validating current availability before recommending, buying, or applying; cleaning stale links; and monitoring for page changes.
- Simple per-call pricing model for different endpoints and actions.
